# Rules for every agent and developer in this repo

## Owned pieces: do not edit
- **Service header** (`frontend/src/components/service-header/`): the Mini App top header and service switcher of both
  apps (خانه and باربری). Do not edit, restyle, move or replace it, and do not render another header. Changes only via
  the header owner session, with Mohammad's approval. See `frontend/src/components/service-header/OWNERS.md`.
